title: Qualify bounded exact Math display safety, restrictions and LaTeX ambiguity
commitMessage: feat: qualify canonical Math display boundaries and close C01

contribution.summary: Qualify an independent canonical Math display audit: bounded renderer-generated LaTeX commands, structural text/IR replay, exclusion binding, contradictory assumptions and explicit square/power-two display collisions. Require a compiled missing-API RED, 51 GREEN tests, eight isolated NuGet probes and three local package inspections. Close only C01-T2 and C01; keep M5-W01, M5 and bounded LaTeX import open.
contribution.value: Give independent .NET callers a precise safe-display, original-domain and presentation-loss boundary without inventing TeX execution or reversible typography.
